Results.ReviewText: I was a little hesitant to buy this grill due to the price. But in the past I have always bought cheap grills and they never last. They almost self destruct. I took a chance on the Weber Spirit II. As soon as you take the pieces out of the box you immediately see the difference in quality. No more keeping wrenches on hand for a wobbly stand that won't stay tight. This grill is not only beautiful in side and out, it's built like a tank. My wife and I truly enjoy using this grill. If you're in the market for a new grill forget the big box store grills and buy a Weber. You'll be glad you did. Do like I did, research the product, read reviews, and find people who already have a Weber.
Results.Title: Good Purchase

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I am glad I spent the extra money to purchase the Weber Grill.  I am pleased with the grill overall.  I thought I would miss having a side burner, but so far I am fine with it.
Results.Title: Great Warranty, and good reviews

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I’ve had this grill for about a month and love it! The food cooks evenly, and hears well. Clean up is quick and easy.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: This is the first Weber grill that I have owned and it won’t be the last. I’ve always heard a lot of good things about the grill from family and friends but hadn’t purchased one until recently. It lives up to all the great reviews and I’m sorry I waited so long to purchase one. The cooking is even and it’s very functional and easy to clean. I love it!!
Results.Title: Excellent cooking surface.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After researching many grills, we finally decided on this Weber grill.  We bought a floor model so it was already assembled so can't comment on that, but I can say it heats up very quickly and grills very evenly.  We are very happy with this purchase.
Results.Title: Love this grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: I bought this grill a month ago and so far I have to say you get what you pay for. This grill is the best I ever owned so far. Weber sells quality, no doubt. At this point I couldn't be more pleased!
Results.Title: Perfect grill for my needs.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Better than my old Char Broil; the Weber has a better heat distribution and a great warranty. The directions were straight forward and assembly was easy. Don’t hesitate, just buy the Weber and you will be very happy.
Results.Title: Great at cooking steaks

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
